ac_evidence.ac: CI failure classified as auto-fixable → run deterministic fixers BEFORE LLM
Built-in fixers: goimports -w ., go mod tidy, go fmt ./...
After fixer runs: git diff --quiet to check if anything changed
If fixer produced changes: commit, push, wait for CI re-run
If fixer didn't help: fall through to LLM fix path
Each fixer has name, command, applies_to, timeout
Fixer execution logged in run file with timing
Test: fixer resolves import issue, fixer doesn't help → LLM fallback
